integrity: The exact slice bound is proved by direct norm inequalities and exhibited unit transverse witnesses. The local strong-rotundity index is obtained by inversion, treating p=1 and infinity separately. Finite checker tests are supplementary. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local support-pair index on a scalar ell_p summand; not the global infimum over all support pairs. The p=2 special case was known. Arbitrary transverse nonzero real Banach spaces are allowed. An equivalent unindexed formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact strong-rotundity profiles and singular endpoint laws for scalar \(\ell_p\)-summands
